headline: Sensex tanks 660 points as crude oil surges above $110 and global uncertainties weigh on Indian markets

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices surged above $110 per barrel, increasing pressure on the domestic economy
Uncertainty surrounding the US elections and global geopolitical factors
Significant selling pressure in power and metal sectors dragging the indices lower
Decline in margin-funded stock bets as the smallcap rally falters
whatHappening: Sensex plunged over 600 points while Nifty 50 tumbled below the 22,600 mark
Adani Energy Solutions reported a massive 148% year-on-year jump in Q2 net profit
The Jio IPO witnessed strong investor interest, being subscribed 4.3 times on its second day
Garware Hi-Tech shares crashed 14% following the announcement of its Q2 results
summary: The Indian stock market witnessed a sharp decline today, with the Sensex falling over 660 points due to surging crude oil prices and global uncertainties. While power and metal stocks dragged the indices lower, Adani Energy posted strong Q2 results and the Jio IPO saw robust subscription. Investors lost significant wealth as the Nifty 50 dropped below the 22,600 level.
